scripts.text:
[Veins Guide]
Thank you for coming through the rough sand storms. Welcome to ^8B4513Veins^000000, the Canyon Village.
If this is the first time for you to use the guide services, why don't you check the "Notice" menu first?
scripts.translation:
[伯仁斯向导]
穿越风沙辛苦了，欢迎来到峡谷村庄^8B4513伯仁斯^000000。
第一次找向导的话，不妨先看看“告示”菜单。

scripts.text:

When you click on the ^B9062F[location name]^000000, you'll receive the most advanced ^B9062FNavigation^000000 services!
scripts.translation:

The <NAVI>[Temple]<INFO>veins,197,256,0,000,0</INFO></NAVI> is always filled with praying the faithful of the incarnation of goddess Freya.
It's located on the North side of Veins.
Would you like to check any other locations?
